qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Installed base of >600,000 systems creates deep clinical and software switching costs, generating ~45% recurring high-margin service revenue. Technological lead in photon-counting CT and Varian radiation oncology monopolies protect pricing power across hospital procurement cycles.
qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. Global duopoly in medical imaging (MRI/CT) and monopoly in radiation oncology (Varian). Deep workflow switching costs with ~45% recurring high-margin service revenue. Solid ~8x interest coverage and ~97% FCF conversion. [5-10Y g: Imaging/Varian volume 4.5% + price/mix 1.5% + margin/deleverage 1.5%]
qualitative.evidence: Median GAAP ROIC 13.2% (tangible ROIC >20%), FCF conversion ~97%. Over €23B in revenues with dominant market shares in advanced therapies, MRI/CT, and linear accelerators. 8.1x EBIT interest coverage with net debt/EBITDA ~1.2-1.5x.
